title: A Survey of Text Style Transfer: Applications and Ethical Implications

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing text style transfer (TST) methods for controllable text revision, such as masking and regenerating verbs associated with power or agency to correct implicit biases in character portrayals, and using lexical substitution to obfuscate gender.

Demonstrating the use of text style transfer (TST) to rephrase sentences containing ableist language into more inclusive terminology (e.g., rewriting 'physically handicapped' to 'physical disability').
